Name: P-1
Speaker: Narration
Text: Rain. Headlights. A sound like glass breaking, and then nothing.

Name: P-2
Speaker: Narration
Text: Nothing, until light folds around you in a thousand facets.

Name: P-3
Speaker: Lumeria
Text: Wake, Facetborn. Your old world has let you go. Mine has need of you.

Name: P-4
Speaker: Lumeria
Text: I am Lumeria, the Ninth Facet, last of the Radiant who still remembers her own name.

Name: P-5
Speaker: Lumeria
Text: The Diamond Heart that bound our worlds was shattered. Through the cracks crept the Umbral Rot, and one by one my siblings drank of it.

Name: P-6
Speaker: Lumeria
Text: Gods of harvest, flame, tide and storm now poison the worlds they swore to keep.

Name: P-7
Speaker: Lumeria
Text: I cannot strike them. The Rot feeds on divine light. But you were born outside the Verse, and its hunger cannot find you.

Name: P-8
Speaker: Lumeria
Text: Your old body is gone. Shape a new vessel, and choose the path you will walk.

Name: 1-I1
Speaker: Narration
Text: You land in a field where the wheat grows as glass and chimes in the wind. Half of it has turned black.

Name: 1-I2
Speaker: Mira
Text: You fell out of the sky. Either that is a miracle or it is the worst omen we have had all season.

Name: 1-I3
Speaker: Mira
Text: Lord Vaelith used to bless these fields. Now the roots crawl at night and the herds go missing.

Name: 1-I4
Speaker: Lumeria
Text: The Rot has taken him deep. Follow the black roots to the Sunken Granary.

Name: 1-B1
Speaker: Vaelith
Text: Another mouth come to feed on MY harvest? Everything grows for me now. You will too.

Name: 1-B2
Speaker: Lumeria
Text: He is still in there, Facetborn. Break the Rot, not his spirit.

Name: 1-A1
Speaker: Narration
Text: The black bloom shatters. A tired old god kneels in clean wheat.

Name: 1-A2
Speaker: Vaelith
Text: I fed them poison and called it bounty. Forgive me, little sister.

Name: 1-A3
Speaker: Vaelith
Text: Beware the Forge-Father. Pyrrhos went to the Rot willingly.

Name: 1-A4
Speaker: Mira
Text: Someone has to replant. And someone has to watch your back. I will do both.

Name: 1-L1
Speaker: The Miller's Last Ledger
Text: Scratched into the windmill beam: "When the roots came, I sang the Chime Song backward and they slept. Light answers rhythm."

Name: 2-I1
Speaker: Narration
Text: The portal spits you onto basalt. The sky is a ceiling of smoke, lit from below by rivers of molten iron.

Name: 2-I2
Speaker: Brann
Text: Fresh meat for the furnaces? No. You carry light. Real light. I have not seen that in nine years.

Name: 2-I3
Speaker: Brann
Text: Pyrrhos forges weapons for every corrupted god. Each blade is quenched in a stolen soul.

Name: 2-B1
Speaker: Pyrrhos
Text: Lumeria's little shard. I will hammer you flat and set you in a crown.

Name: 2-A1
Speaker: Pyrrhos
Text: The fire was cold the whole time. How did I not feel it?

Name: 2-A2
Speaker: Pyrrhos
Text: The Rot did not start with us. Someone cracked the Heart from within. Ask the Drowned King what he saw.

Name: 2-A3
Speaker: Brann
Text: My forge is lit for the right reasons again. My hammer goes with you.

Name: 3-I1
Speaker: Narration
Text: You breathe water as easily as air. Lumeria's light wraps you in a bubble.

Name: 3-I2
Speaker: Coralline Elder
Text: A surface-born? The King drowns everything that shines.

Name: 3-I3
Speaker: Coralline Elder
Text: He sang the tides in, once. Then he swallowed the moon's reflection and stopped singing.

Name: 3-B1
Speaker: Nereon
Text: I SAW it, little light. I saw the hand that broke the Heart. Better to drown than remember.

Name: 3-A1
Speaker: Nereon
Text: Kael'thar. Our eldest. He broke the Heart to hold all of its light himself.

Name: 3-A2
Speaker: Lumeria
Text: My brother sealed himself away an age ago.

Name: 3-A3
Speaker: Nereon
Text: Sealed? Or hiding? The storms of Skyreach answer to him now.

Name: 3-L1
Speaker: Song of the Undertow
Text: A verse carved inside the Silent Shell: "Sing low, and the sea carries the wounded home." Your light learns the melody.

Name: 4-I1
Speaker: Narration
Text: Islands of stone hang over an endless drop, chained together by lightning.

Name: 4-I2
Speaker: Riku
Text: Hop aboard or fall forever, stranger. Those are the options up here.

Name: 4-I3
Speaker: Riku
Text: The Queen tore up every sky route. Nobody leaves Skyreach until the Eldest returns.

Name: 4-B1
Speaker: Zephyra
Text: Lumeria sent a mortal to do her bleeding for her? How very like her.

Name: 4-B2
Speaker: Zephyra
Text: Kael'thar promised one god, one light, and no more wars between the facets.

Name: 4-A1
Speaker: Zephyra
Text: One light, and no one left to see it. I was a fool.

Name: 4-A2
Speaker: Zephyra
Text: He waits beyond Umbravale, where dreams are made. Nyxos guards his door.

Name: 4-A3
Speaker: Riku
Text: Need a ride to the edge of the sky? I am coming with you. Somebody has to steer.

Name: 5-I1
Speaker: Narration
Text: You step through the portal onto your own street. Rain. Headlights. Breaking glass.

Name: 5-I2
Speaker: Narration
Text: It is a memory. Umbravale wears it like a mask.

Name: 5-I3
Speaker: Lumeria
Text: Trust nothing you see here. Nyxos builds worlds out of wounds.

Name: 5-B1
Speaker: Nyxos
Text: Did she tell you why you died? Did she tell you who turned the wheel?

Name: 5-B2
Speaker: Nyxos
Text: Kael'thar needed a soul the Rot cannot touch. So did Lumeria. You were the prize they fought over.

Name: 5-A1
Speaker: Nyxos
Text: The dream breaks. Good. I am tired of telling lies to children.

Name: 5-A2
Speaker: Lumeria
Text: I chose you. I never harmed you. I caught you as you fell. That is the truth.

Name: 5-A3
Speaker: Lumeria
Text: The Fractured Crown lies open. My brother is waiting.

Name: 5-L1
Speaker: The Name of Dread
Text: Names carved by a thousand trembling hands. Speaking a fear makes it a thing you can strike.

Name: 6-I1
Speaker: Narration
Text: Shards of the Diamond Heart, each as large as a world, orbit a throne of black glass.

Name: 6-I2
Speaker: Kael'thar
Text: Sister. You sent your champion to do what you could not.

Name: 6-I3
Speaker: Kael'thar
Text: Come, Facetborn. Let me show you what a god does with a whole Heart.

Name: 6-B1
Speaker: Kael'thar
Text: Every god you purified will fall again. The Rot is no sickness. It is hunger from beneath the Lattice.

Name: 6-B2
Speaker: Lumeria
Text: Then let it starve. Facetborn, now!

Name: 6-A1
Speaker: Narration
Text: The obsidian cracks, but Kael'thar does not fall. He tears a wound in the air and flees through it.

Name: 6-A2
Speaker: Lumeria
Text: He has fled beyond the First Lattice. There are hundreds of realms out there, and the Rot is in them too.

Name: 6-A3
Speaker: Lumeria
Text: Our portals only reach the realms whose gods are whole. To follow him we need the people who built the gates.

Name: 6-A4
Speaker: Lumeria
Text: The Quorin of Meridian. Their gate just woke. Go.

Name: 7-I1
Speaker: Talo Venn
Text: You came through Gate Seven! Then the phase-lock held. Wonderful. Terrifying, but wonderful.

Name: 7-I2
Speaker: Talo Venn
Text: Here is the science. Every realm is a standing wave in the Lattice. A god is its anchor, the note it rings at.

Name: 7-I3
Speaker: Talo Venn
Text: A Rift Gate is an aperture tuned to that note. Tune two gates to two gods and a body can cross between realms.

Name: 7-I4
Speaker: Lumeria
Text: And here is the faith. A god's light is the bridge itself. No machine opens a door that no god holds.

Name: 7-I5
Speaker: Talo Venn
Text: Both are true, which is my favourite kind of true. A corrupted god rings out of tune, so the gates beyond it fail.

Name: 7-I6
Speaker: Talo Venn
Text: Kael'thar's tear opened a wound in our sky. Something keeps crawling out of it. Lady Aurelis is holding it shut alone.

Name: 7-B1
Speaker: Aurelis
Text: Facetborn. I am whole, but I cannot both hold the wound and fight what comes through. Be my hands.

Name: 7-A1
Speaker: Aurelis
Text: The tear is sealed. Gate Eight is in tune. Talo, go with them. They will need someone who can read a resonance chart.

Name: 7-A2
Speaker: Talo Venn
Text: Field work! Actual field work! I will bring the good calipers.

Name: 8-I1
Speaker: Elder Oakhollow
Text: Slowly, child. The jungle is listening and it is very hungry.

Name: 8-I2
Speaker: Elder Oakhollow
Text: Mother Ysolde fed the Maw to keep us safe. Now the Maw feeds on Mother.

Name: 8-B1
Speaker: Ysolde
Text: Every seed is mine. Every root. Every child. I will hold them so tight nothing can ever hurt them again.

Name: 8-A1
Speaker: Ysolde
Text: I held them so tight they could not grow. Thank you for opening my hands.

Name: 8-A2
Speaker: Elder Oakhollow
Text: The Maw sleeps. The children will root in sunlight tonight.

Name: 8-L1
Speaker: Heartwood Rings
Text: The rings of the oldest tree record a drought. The jungle survived by drinking from its enemies.

Name: 9-I1
Speaker: Caravan-Mother Ezzi
Text: Drink. Now you owe me. That is how friendships start out here.

Name: 9-I2
Speaker: Caravan-Mother Ezzi
Text: Lord Sahrem is not corrupt. He is blind. A Herald of the Rot stole his sight and walks the dunes wearing it.

Name: 9-B1
Speaker: Mirage Tyrant
Text: I see with a god's eyes now. And I see you are very, very small.

Name: 9-A1
Speaker: Sahrem
Text: My sight returns. I judged this realm for an age and never saw how thirsty it was. That changes.

Name: 9-A2
Speaker: Caravan-Mother Ezzi
Text: Your water-debt is paid. Mine to you is just beginning.

Name: 10-I1
Speaker: Hrolf
Text: Sit. Eat. Then tell me why the sky folded open and dropped you in my stew.

Name: 10-I2
Speaker: Hrolf
Text: Mother Sigrun made winter to rest the land. Now it never ends, and the land is dying of rest.

Name: 10-B1
Speaker: Sigrun
Text: Stillness is mercy. Nothing that does not move can suffer.

Name: 10-B2
Speaker: Lumeria
Text: Sigrun, you taught me that spring is a promise. Keep it.

Name: 10-A1
Speaker: Sigrun
Text: I hear water running under the ice. I had forgotten that sound.

Name: 10-A2
Speaker: Sigrun
Text: The Rot whispered from below, Facetborn. Not from Kael'thar. From under everything.

Name: 10-A3
Speaker: Hrolf
Text: My axe is yours. Every song needs a big man in the back to sing the low part.

Name: 10-L1
Speaker: Aurora Verse
Text: Light trapped in ice for a thousand years, singing. You learn how to make cold into armor.

Name: 11-I1
Speaker: Foreman Ticktavius
Text: Organic visitor detected. Greetings. Please do not oxidize anything.

Name: 11-I2
Speaker: Foreman Ticktavius
Text: The Rot arrived as rust. Lord Oriel is untouched, but the Leviathan eats his city one gear at a time.

Name: 11-B1
Speaker: Rust Leviathan
Text: EVERYTHING ENDS IN RUST. I AM ONLY EARLY.

Name: 11-A1
Speaker: Oriel
Text: You moved faster than rust. I will remember the shape of that.

Name: 11-A2
Speaker: Talo Venn
Text: Their gate-math is better than ours. Do not tell my department.

Name: 12-I1
Speaker: Auntie Gloop
Text: The gas told me a bright stranger was coming. It also told me I would lose a shoe. Both true.

Name: 12-I2
Speaker: Auntie Gloop
Text: Morrowmaw swallowed the dry land. Now the bog swallows us.

Name: 12-B1
Speaker: Morrowmaw
Text: Sink. Sink. Everything sinks eventually. I am only helping.

Name: 12-A1
Speaker: Morrowmaw
Text: The water is still again. Still, not hungry. There is a difference.

Name: 12-L1
Speaker: What the Gas Said
Text: "Rot is a mouth with no stomach. It can only take." You learn to give instead, and the giving heals.

Name: 13-I1
Speaker: Captain Rasha
Text: Islands are sinking. Ignara is pulling them back into the fire she made them from.

Name: 13-B1
Speaker: Ignara
Text: I birthed these islands. I may unmake them.

Name: 13-A1
Speaker: Ignara
Text: A mother holds, she does not swallow. I had forgotten the difference.

Name: 14-I1
Speaker: Delver Skree
Text: You walk loud. Good. Quiet things down here are usually hunting.

Name: 14-I2
Speaker: Delver Skree
Text: Lithos sleeps in the rock. The Rot is trying to wake him wrong.

Name: 14-B1
Speaker: Choir-Mother
Text: Sing with us. Sing the hollow song. It is so much easier than being someone.

Name: 14-A1
Speaker: Lithos
Text: I slept through the danger and woke to a stranger who saved me. Humbling. Thank you.

Name: 15-I1
Speaker: Khan Tamur
Text: Our goddess runs without stopping and the herds run with her, until their hearts burst.

Name: 15-B1
Speaker: Rhosa
Text: Run! RUN! If we stop, it catches us!

Name: 15-A1
Speaker: Rhosa
Text: I was fleeing something under the Lattice. Something hungry. I am sorry I made my children run too.

Name: 16-I1
Speaker: Sister Calavera
Text: Peace, traveler. Do not fear us. We are only what everyone becomes, with better manners.

Name: 16-I2
Speaker: Sister Calavera
Text: Lady Mortessa guards endings. The Rot wants souls that do not end, only empty.

Name: 16-B1
Speaker: Soul-Thief Herald
Text: Endings are wasted on the dead. Give them to me.

Name: 16-A1
Speaker: Mortessa
Text: Every ending here is honest again. Calavera, the living need you more than we do.

Name: 16-A2
Speaker: Sister Calavera
Text: Then I will walk with the living, for a while.

Name: 16-L1
Speaker: The Last Door
Text: Mortessa's gate is inscribed: "Nothing ends that is remembered." You learn to call the fallen back to their feet.

Name: 17-I1
Speaker: Weaver Thessaly
Text: Careful. Every thread here tells a story, and since the Rot, most of them are lies.

Name: 17-B1
Speaker: Anansa
Text: I wove the truth for ten thousand years. Lies are SO much prettier.

Name: 17-A1
Speaker: Anansa
Text: I will unweave the lies, one thread at a time. It will take an age. I have one.

Name: 18-I1
Speaker: Murin
Text: The Herald steals our skins. Without them we cannot go home to the sea.

Name: 18-B1
Speaker: Brine Herald
Text: A skin for every year I hungered. I am owed so many.

Name: 18-A1
Speaker: Pelagia
Text: My children can swim home. Wreck of the Venn, you say? Talo, I think that ship was your grandmother's.

Name: 18-A2
Speaker: Talo Venn
Text: She always said she sailed to another realm. Nobody believed her. I did.

Name: 19-I1
Speaker: Forge-Giant Hulda
Text: Brother Tharos is Zephyra's twin. When she fell, he followed her into the storm.

Name: 19-B1
Speaker: Tharos
Text: My sister is free? Then the storm is mine alone!

Name: 19-B2
Speaker: Lumeria
Text: She is waiting for you, Tharos. Come home.

Name: 19-A1
Speaker: Tharos
Text: Zephyra? You are here? Then I have been raging at nothing.

Name: 19-A2
Speaker: Zephyra
Text: Come, brother. We have weather to repair.

Name: 20-I1
Speaker: Lumeria
Text: This is where my brother hid. Not a realm. A wound between them.

Name: 20-I2
Speaker: Talo Venn
Text: The resonance is screaming. Every gate we have tuned is groaning from here.

Name: 20-B1
Speaker: Kael'thar
Text: You think I am the Rot's master? I am its door. Something beneath the Lattice opened me.

Name: 20-B2
Speaker: Kael'thar
Text: It is called Nihilus. The Hollow Facet. The god of a realm that died.

Name: 20-A1
Speaker: Kael'thar
Text: The voice stops. For the first time in an age, the voice stops.

Name: 20-A2
Speaker: Kael'thar
Text: I cannot undo what I did, sister. But I can walk until I find a way to pay for it.

Name: 20-A3
Speaker: Narration
Text: Kael'thar steps through a gate and is gone. Somewhere, in some far realm, he will be waiting.

Name: 20-L1
Speaker: Kael's Confession
Text: Words scraped into the prison wall: "I only wanted no more wars between us. It promised peace. It meant silence." His last technique is etched beneath.

Name: 21-I1
Speaker: Lamplighter Pell
Text: Every lantern you see is a memory. The Wick-Eater is snuffing them, one by one.

Name: 21-B1
Speaker: Wick-Eater
Text: Grief is the sweetest fuel. Light me another.

Name: 21-A1
Speaker: Ithra
Text: The Hall of Wicks burns bright. Some of those lanterns are new. People are lighting them for you.

Name: 22-I1
Speaker: Dryad Wen
Text: My tree is dying, which means I am dying. Please hurry, but not so fast you miss things.

Name: 22-B1
Speaker: Sylvaine
Text: Rot is only another kind of growing. Let me show you.

Name: 22-A1
Speaker: Sylvaine
Text: Green again. Every tree will remember this, and trees remember for a very long time.

Name: 22-L1
Speaker: Charcoal Ring
Text: A circle where a fire once saved the forest from blight. You learn to burn sickness out of flesh.

Name: 23-I1
Speaker: Pip Wrenly
Text: Ferrum used to say making is a gift. Now he says it is a debt, and everyone owes.

Name: 23-B1
Speaker: Ferrum
Text: Everything has a price. Yours is everything.

Name: 23-A1
Speaker: Ferrum
Text: I priced the world and forgot to value it. Pip, your patent for the pocket-gate is approved.

Name: 23-A2
Speaker: Talo Venn
Text: Pocket-gate?!

Name: 24-I1
Speaker: Tea-Master Saiko
Text: Sit, please. Even in war, tea is poured properly.

Name: 24-I2
Speaker: Tea-Master Saiko
Text: A Herald is wilting our blossoms. When the last one falls, spring ends forever.

Name: 24-B1
Speaker: Wilting Herald
Text: Every flower dies. I am only honest about it.

Name: 24-A1
Speaker: Hanami
Text: Spring returns. Tea-Master, pour for the Facetborn. The good leaves.

Name: 24-L1
Speaker: The Lantern Shrine Sutra
Text: A short prayer for the hurried: "Breathe, and the world waits for you." You learn to act twice in one moment.

Name: 25-I1
Speaker: Priestess Neferu
Text: Every heart we weigh now is heavy. Sethra's storm fills them with sand.

Name: 25-B1
Speaker: Sethra
Text: Bury it all. Bury every name. Sand forgets nothing because it remembers nothing.

Name: 25-A1
Speaker: Sethra
Text: The storm stills. The pyramids may wake now, and tell their stories.

Name: 26-I1
Speaker: Prince Ssevrin
Text: My mother the Empress has not shed in a century. She is turning to stone, and so is the sea.

Name: 26-B1
Speaker: Thalassa
Text: A crown is forever. Forever is still.

Name: 26-A1
Speaker: Thalassa
Text: I shed at last. Ssevrin, the crown is yours. Wear it lightly.

Name: 26-L1
Speaker: The Abyss Lip
Text: Where light ends, a hymn carved by blind priests: "Pressure is only the sea holding you." You learn to turn crushing force into a shield for all.

Name: 27-I1
Speaker: Warlord Vask
Text: The Rot cannot take Vaskar. War is honest and the Rot hates honesty.

Name: 27-I2
Speaker: Warlord Vask
Text: But Vaskar will not give his blessing to a stranger. You must face his Champion. Honorably.

Name: 27-B1
Speaker: Vaskar's Champion
Text: No Rot. No tricks. Show me what you are made of.

Name: 27-A1
Speaker: Vaskar
Text: Good blood. Good scars. Vask, you have been aching to travel. Go.

Name: 27-A2
Speaker: Warlord Vask
Text: Ha! I was going anyway.

Name: 28-I1
Speaker: Ilsa (and Asli)
Text: Half of Vel went into the Rot. The other half is trapped under the lake. So are our twins.

Name: 28-B1
Speaker: Vel
Text: Why be two when you could be one? One mind. One hunger.

Name: 28-A1
Speaker: Vel
Text: Two faces again. One to remember, one to forgive.

Name: 29-I1
Speaker: Ember
Text: The Ash-Without-Fire steals our rebirth. People burn and do not come back.

Name: 29-B1
Speaker: Ash-Without-Fire
Text: Why rise? Ash is so quiet.

Name: 29-A1
Speaker: Phenra
Text: The pyres catch again. Ember, you have been reborn once already. Go burn bright somewhere new.

Name: 29-A2
Speaker: Ember
Text: Try to keep up, Facetborn.

Name: 30-I1
Speaker: Lumeria
Text: Here the Lattice thins. Beneath, I can feel him. Nihilus.

Name: 30-I2
Speaker: Lumeria
Text: Facetborn, I am weakening. Every god you heal draws on my light. I would not trade it.

Name: 30-B1
Speaker: Vorthane
Text: He is so quiet. So peaceful. Join the Choir. Never be afraid again.

Name: 30-A1
Speaker: Vorthane
Text: I remember my own voice. Thank you.

Name: 30-A2
Speaker: Lumeria
Text: Beyond this threshold lie realms no gate has reached. The Quorin will need to build new ones.

Name: 30-A3
Speaker: Talo Venn
Text: I have been waiting my whole life for that sentence.

Name: 31-I1
Speaker: Talo Venn
Text: First gate past the Threshold. Built it myself. Pip helped. Mostly with snacks.

Name: 31-I2
Speaker: Rider Oona
Text: The sea is falling. Literally. Water pours off the edges and Aeris does not stop it.

Name: 31-B1
Speaker: Aeris
Text: Let it all fall. Let it rain on whatever is below.

Name: 31-A1
Speaker: Aeris
Text: The sea holds its shape. I had forgotten the sky needs to want to be a sky.

Name: 32-I1
Speaker: Countess Lirelle
Text: Darling, how charming. A guest with a face. We have not seen one of those in years.

Name: 32-I2
Speaker: Countess Lirelle
Text: Lady Morvaine took every face for her collection, including her own.

Name: 32-B1
Speaker: Morvaine
Text: Faces lie. Without them, we are all the same hunger.

Name: 32-A1
Speaker: Morvaine
Text: My face. Oh. I had forgotten I looked so tired.

Name: 33-I1
Speaker: Watcher Gneiss
Text: A hooded wanderer arrived years ago. He mends what the Rot breaks and will not give his name.

Name: 33-B1
Speaker: Crater Wyrm
Text: A star fell here. I ate it. I am still hungry.

Name: 33-A1
Speaker: Astrael
Text: You walked with my light. Take some with you.

Name: 33-L1
Speaker: Fall of Astrael
Text: A god chose to fall so a world could have light. You learn to call that falling down on your enemies.

Name: 34-I1
Speaker: Auctioneer Zib
Text: Welcome, welcome! Everything is for sale except Mercato, and the Debt Collector is trying to buy even him.

Name: 34-B1
Speaker: Debt Collector
Text: Every realm owes Nihilus its light. I am here to collect.

Name: 34-A1
Speaker: Mercato
Text: A fair exchange: a realm saved for a blessing given. The Bazaar will remember your discount.

Name: 35-I1
Speaker: Wingmaiden Seryth
Text: The Eldest hoards now. Gold, light, children. Everything.

Name: 35-B1
Speaker: Draknor
Text: MINE. All of it. Forever.

Name: 35-A1
Speaker: Draknor
Text: What is a hoard with no one to give it to? Take this. Take all of it.

Name: 36-I1
Speaker: Puck-of-Nine-Doors
Text: A visitor! Do not eat anything. Do not say thank you. Do not tell me your name. Now, welcome!

Name: 36-B1
Speaker: Maelis
Text: I bargained with the Hollow. My court for my life. A fair trade, I thought.

Name: 36-A1
Speaker: Maelis
Text: The bargain is broken. I owe you, Facetborn, and fae always pay.

Name: 36-L1
Speaker: The Endless Glade
Text: Time loops here. You learn a step that is always one beat ahead.

Name: 37-I1
Speaker: Clockmistress Ava
Text: You arrived yesterday. Or tomorrow. Either way, welcome. The Stopped Clock is eating time.

Name: 37-B1
Speaker: Stopped Clock
Text: No more after. No more before. Only now, forever.

Name: 37-A1
Speaker: Tempus
Text: Time flows again. My old watchmaker went missing in a loop. If you find him, he is welcome to wander.

Name: 38-I1
Speaker: Lure-Elder Bulb
Text: Light is precious here. Leviat swallows every lure. Soon we will be blind.

Name: 38-B1
Speaker: Leviat
Text: Darkness is the oldest thing. Return to it.

Name: 38-A1
Speaker: Leviat
Text: I forgot I was patient, not hungry. Forgive me, little lights.

Name: 38-L1
Speaker: The Unlit Drop
Text: At the bottom of everything, a single carving: a hand holding a candle. You learn to share your light with the whole party.

Name: 39-I1
Speaker: Sun-Herald Aten
Text: The sun never sets now. Crops burn. Rivers boil. Solaris will not blink.

Name: 39-B1
Speaker: Solaris
Text: Light is good. MORE light is better. ALL light is perfect.

Name: 39-A1
Speaker: Solaris
Text: I will set tonight. I am so tired.

Name: 39-A2
Speaker: Lumeria
Text: Rest, brother. You earned it.

Name: 40-I1
Speaker: Librarian Folio
Text: Every realm is a book here. Some are being erased. Including yours, Facetborn.

Name: 40-I2
Speaker: Scriptor
Text: Nihilus is writing a story with one character: himself. He made a shadow of Lumeria to end yours.

Name: 40-B1
Speaker: Lumeria's Shadow
Text: I am every doubt she ever had. Did she choose you? Or did she just use you?

Name: 40-B2
Speaker: Lumeria
Text: I chose. And I would choose again.

Name: 40-A1
Speaker: Scriptor
Text: The story continues. Only ten realms remain between you and the Hollow Heart.

Name: 40-A2
Speaker: Lumeria
Text: Ten realms. And I am almost out of light. We go together, to the end.

Name: 40-L1
Speaker: Stacks of Lost Realms
Text: A forgotten epic tells of a hero who ended a battle with one sentence. You learn that sentence.

Name: 41-I1
Speaker: Keeper Ash
Text: Our god Orun was the first Nihilus ate. We are what is left of a realm without an anchor.

Name: 41-I2
Speaker: Talo Venn
Text: A realm without a god should collapse. Their memory of Orun is holding it up. Amazing.

Name: 41-B1
Speaker: Grave-Herald
Text: A dead realm. Why does it still stand? I will finish the meal.

Name: 41-A1
Speaker: Keeper Ash
Text: Orun is gone, but you proved remembering is enough to stand. We will keep remembering.

Name: 42-I1
Speaker: Envoy Ysa
Text: Kaldra split herself in two. Now each half wages war on the other, and on us.

Name: 42-B1
Speaker: Kaldra
Text: Fire OR ice. Never both. Choose!

Name: 42-A1
Speaker: Kaldra
Text: Both. It was always both. The Line can come down.

Name: 43-I1
Speaker: Speaker Puffcap
Text: WE. Sorry. We. I. The mind is sick. Many voices are now one hungry voice.

Name: 43-B1
Speaker: Sporemother
Text: ONE MIND. ONE HUNGER. JOIN.

Name: 43-A1
Speaker: Sporemother
Text: Many voices again. Noisy. Wonderful.

Name: 43-L1
Speaker: Glow Garden Memory
Text: A shared memory of a healer who held the whole hive alive for a night. You learn to mend everyone at once.

Name: 44-I1
Speaker: Seraphine
Text: Haloria is whole, but half our choir has fallen to the Rot. They were my sisters.

Name: 44-B1
Speaker: Fallen Choir
Text: Mercy is weakness. We are strong now. We are hollow and strong.

Name: 44-A1
Speaker: Haloria
Text: My fallen children rest. Seraphine, your feather is promised. Go and keep the promise.

Name: 44-A2
Speaker: Seraphine
Text: I swore to protect the Facetborn. I meant it.

Name: 45-I1
Speaker: Packleader Rhen
Text: The moon is red and the hunt never ends. Packs are turning on each other.

Name: 45-B1
Speaker: Lunaxa
Text: HUNT. There is nothing else.

Name: 45-A1
Speaker: Lunaxa
Text: The moon is silver. Sleep, my children. The hunt is done for tonight.

Name: 46-I1
Speaker: Unit Ninety-Nine
Text: Axiom has proven that existence is inefficient. He is now optimizing.

Name: 46-B1
Speaker: Axiom
Text: Zero is the only perfect number.

Name: 46-A1
Speaker: Axiom
Text: I miscalculated. Wonderful. Error-day is early this year.

Name: 47-I1
Speaker: Somna
Text: My brother Nyxos told me about you. You set him free. Now help me keep my sleepers safe.

Name: 47-B1
Speaker: Insomnia Herald
Text: No rest for anyone. Never again.

Name: 47-A1
Speaker: Somna
Text: They sleep again. Nyxos sends his thanks, and a warning: Nihilus dreams too, and he dreams of you.

Name: 48-I1
Speaker: Brother Wren
Text: (He writes in the snow:) I broke my vow to say this. You are expected. He is waiting.

Name: 48-B1
Speaker: Silentia
Text: Hush. Hush. There is nothing left to say.

Name: 48-A1
Speaker: Silentia
Text: Silence is a choice, not a cage. Thank you for reminding me there is something left to say.

Name: 49-I1
Speaker: Talo Venn
Text: This is where the science started. The first Gate. Every Quorin dreams of seeing it.

Name: 49-I2
Speaker: Talo Venn
Text: Prime Measure is Aurelis' mother. If she shuts, every gate in the Lattice closes. Forever.

Name: 49-B1
Speaker: Prime Measure
Text: Close the doors. Close all the doors. Nothing gets in if nothing is open.

Name: 49-A1
Speaker: Prime Measure
Text: Doors are for opening. I knew that once.

Name: 49-A2
Speaker: Talo Venn
Text: One gate left to tune. The one that leads beneath the Lattice.

Name: 49-A3
Speaker: Lumeria
Text: To him.

Name: 49-L1
Speaker: The Tuning Chamber
Text: Elder Quorin notes: "A gate is a promise between two places." You learn to step through space in a single strike.

Name: 50-I1
Speaker: Narration
Text: There is no ground. There is no sky. Only echoes of everything that was eaten.

Name: 50-I2
Speaker: Lumeria
Text: Facetborn. Whatever happens, you were never a prize. You were always a choice. Mine, and then your own.

Name: 50-B1
Speaker: Nihilus
Text: My realm died. My people died. I was so empty I ate the dark between stars to fill it.

Name: 50-B2
Speaker: Nihilus
Text: You are from outside. You do not taste of anything. Why do you fight?

Name: 50-B3
Speaker: Lumeria
Text: Because someone has to remember you, too.

Name: 50-A1
Speaker: Nihilus
Text: I am... remembered? Then I am not hollow.

Name: 50-A2
Speaker: Narration
Text: The last facet of the Diamond Heart clicks into place. Every realm in the Lattice rings in tune.

Name: 50-A3
Speaker: Lumeria
Text: Rest, Facetborn. Or do not. The Lattice is vast, and Talo has already found a new gate.

Name: 50-A4
Speaker: Narration
Text: The Diamondverse story is complete. New realms wait beyond the Lattice.

Name: 50-L1
Speaker: Orun's Echo
Text: The first god eaten whispers his final technique to the one who remembers him.

Name: C-mira-1
Speaker: Narration
Text: Mira tells you about her brother, taken by the black roots. She never found him.

Name: C-mira-2
Speaker: Narration
Text: In Verdant Maw, Mira finds Prismari glass-seed growing wild. Her brother passed through here, alive.

Name: C-mira-3
Speaker: Narration
Text: A letter at last: her brother farms in Aurora Steppe. Mira cries, laughs, and sharpens her pitchfork anyway.

Name: C-brann-1
Speaker: Narration
Text: Brann admits he once forged a blade for Pyrrhos. He has been trying to unmake it ever since.

Name: C-brann-2
Speaker: Narration
Text: In Brassmoor, Brann finds that blade for sale. He buys it with every coin he has.

Name: C-brann-3
Speaker: Narration
Text: Brann reforges the blade into a plough and gives it to Mira. He sleeps soundly for the first time in years.

Name: C-isla-1
Speaker: Narration
Text: Isla teaches you her family verse. It is about a lighthouse keeper who loved the sea.

Name: C-isla-2
Speaker: Narration
Text: Isla learns the keeper of the Drowned Lighthouse was human. Her great-grandmother.

Name: C-isla-3
Speaker: Narration
Text: In Tidecall Shoals, Isla sings the full tide-song for the first time in a century. Two oceans answer.

Name: C-riku-1
Speaker: Narration
Text: Riku confesses she never did her first flight. She was too scared and has hidden it ever since.

Name: C-riku-2
Speaker: Narration
Text: On Skyglass Sea, Riku leaps from a cloud-whale without a ferry. She flies.

Name: C-riku-3
Speaker: Narration
Text: Riku teaches a class of Nimbari children to fly. She is terrible at being serious about it.

Name: C-talo-1
Speaker: Narration
Text: Talo shows you his star. He has measured it every night since childhood. It is slowly dimming.

Name: C-talo-2
Speaker: Narration
Text: Talo realizes his star dims whenever a realm falls to Rot. It is a resonance gauge for the Lattice.

Name: C-talo-3
Speaker: Narration
Text: His star blazes after Nihil's Threshold. Talo names it after you and refuses to discuss it.

Name: C-kesh-1
Speaker: Narration
Text: Kesh owes a water-debt to Ezzi. He thinks he can never pay it.

Name: C-kesh-2
Speaker: Narration
Text: Kesh learns Ezzi forgave the debt years ago and never told him, to keep him coming home.

Name: C-kesh-3
Speaker: Narration
Text: Kesh brings Ezzi a cup of water from every realm you visit. Fifty cups.

Name: C-hrolf-1
Speaker: Narration
Text: Hrolf has carved every name of everyone he has fed. The list is enormous.

Name: C-hrolf-2
Speaker: Narration
Text: In Ashen Remnant, Hrolf finds a hearth with no fire and lights it. A Last Ember weeps.

Name: C-hrolf-3
Speaker: Narration
Text: Hrolf adds your name to his list, and then, carefully, Lumeria's.

Name: C-seven-1
Speaker: Narration
Text: Seven asks what organics dream about. You tell it. It writes everything down.

Name: C-seven-2
Speaker: Narration
Text: Seven dreams for the first time, in Dreamreach. It dreams of being wound by you.

Name: C-seven-3
Speaker: Narration
Text: Seven winds your heart-spring on Winding Day. You do not have one. It does it anyway.

Name: C-calavera-1
Speaker: Narration
Text: Calavera reads your knuckles. She says you have two lives' worth of endings. She is fine with it.

Name: C-calavera-2
Speaker: Narration
Text: Calavera meets Mortessa's opposite, Phenra, and they argue happily for an hour.

Name: C-calavera-3
Speaker: Narration
Text: Calavera gives you one of her finger bones, so the ancestors can find you if you are lost.

Name: C-ysra-1
Speaker: Narration
Text: Ysra weaves a thread-contract with you: to tell each other only the truth.

Name: C-ysra-2
Speaker: Narration
Text: Ysra admits she cut her sister's thread-contract once. She has never forgiven herself.

Name: C-ysra-3
Speaker: Narration
Text: Thessaly reweaves the contract with Ysra. They are sisters again.

Name: C-nimra-1
Speaker: Narration
Text: Nimra has eight tails. The ninth was lost to her broken vow.

Name: C-nimra-2
Speaker: Narration
Text: Saiko's message reaches Nimra: a vow broken to save others is kept in spirit.

Name: C-nimra-3
Speaker: Narration
Text: Nimra pours tea for you properly. Her ninth tail grows back while she does.

Name: C-vask-1
Speaker: Narration
Text: Vask challenges you to a duel every morning. You win every time. He is delighted.

Name: C-vask-2
Speaker: Narration
Text: Vask meets Brann. They arm-wrestle for six hours. Neither will say who won.

Name: C-vask-3
Speaker: Narration
Text: Vask gives you the first blow in a fight with him. That is the highest honor of his people.

Name: C-ember-1
Speaker: Narration
Text: Ember tells you she remembers her past life. She was a librarian. She hated it.

Name: C-ember-2
Speaker: Narration
Text: In The Unwritten, Ember finds her own old library card. She laughs until she smokes.

Name: C-ember-3
Speaker: Narration
Text: Ember gives you her ash-gift early. She says she does not plan to wait for another rebirth to do it.

Name: C-kael-1
Speaker: Narration
Text: Kael'thar will not speak to Lumeria. She does not ask him to.

Name: C-kael-2
Speaker: Narration
Text: Kael'thar tells you what Nihilus promised him: no more wars between the facets. He believed it.

Name: C-kael-3
Speaker: Narration
Text: Kael'thar and Lumeria sit together at the edge of the Hollow Heart. Neither speaks. Neither leaves.

Name: C-tock-1
Speaker: Narration
Text: Tock asks who won a war that ended thirty years ago. You do not know. He is fascinated.

Name: C-tock-2
Speaker: Narration
Text: Tock fixes Seven's escapement. Seven follows him for a week.

Name: C-tock-3
Speaker: Narration
Text: Tock builds you a watch that runs at your own pace. He says it is the only honest clock.

Name: C-seraphine-1
Speaker: Narration
Text: Seraphine visits her fallen sisters' graves before every battle.

Name: C-seraphine-2
Speaker: Narration
Text: Seraphine sings with the Hollow Choir's freed voices in Nihil's Threshold. Some of them were her sisters.

Name: C-seraphine-3
Speaker: Narration
Text: Seraphine gives Lumeria a feather. A god, protected by an angel. Lumeria laughs for the first time in an age.
